description: a plate 30 x 30 x 3 with a boss of radius 3 and height 5 on its top, its axis 3.5 from the front edge y = 0, the boss's root circle filleted at r 0.6: the pi mount plate's front standoffs, shrunk. The ring's contact on the top, of radius 3.6, leaves the plate through its front edge between x = 14 ± √(3.6² − 3.5²), where the edge meets it 14 degrees off its tangent. Arris builds it (ADR-0071) as it builds blend/standoff-root-fillet-runs-off-the-plate. The rolled face's foot on the boss leaves the torus's contact tangent at each crossing, and at this angle stays within the tolerance of the torus for a long stretch beside it: the tracer holds that stretch as one touch of the rolled face's domain edge, as deep as rounding cannot sign the section there (ADR-0061)

analytic.counts_differ: Open CASCADE splits the ring's torus in two, either side of the rolled patch, joined by an edge at the seam; Arris keeps the torus one face open at the rolled face, its seam inside it (ADR-0071 §2)
